verdict.rationale: Docs confirm test events can be manually selected/sent to trigger a workflow (pipedream-docs-13) and that errors surface with stack traces and AI debugging (pipedream-docs-16/26/37), implying step-level execution visibility, but there's no explicit documentation of a 'pin data' feature or per-step input/output inspection UI before going live. missing for 10: explicit docs on inspecting each step's input/output, data pinning across steps, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow-testing UX.
